activity.title: Típico fin de semana
activity.dl: With a partner, choose to be Estudiante 1 or Estudiante 2. Estudiante 1 will interview Estudiante 2 about what he or she does on a typical weekend. Include these questions in your conversation.

ul.li: What time does he/she leave the house on the weekend?
What does he/she do in the afternoon?
What TV shows does he/she watch?
Does he/she go out with friends?
